target.title: fix(ios): connect iPhone and Watch to protocol v3 gateways
target.body:
Closes #106259

AI-assisted: yes. The implementation was produced with Codex, reviewed with the repository autoreview workflow, and manually verified against the gateway admission contract.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where iPhone nodes—and Apple Watch features relayed through the paired iPhone—could not connect when their Gateway spoke protocol v3, because the shared native WebSocket handshake advertised only protocol v4.

## Why This Change Was Made

The generated Swift protocol surface now exposes the authenticated WebSocket-node compatibility floor alongside the general client floor. Shared Apple connections select v3 only when both role and client mode are `node`; direct Watch HTTPS and operator-only Apple clients remain on v4. The compatibility guard and Swift tests cover generated drift, role-specific selection, the Watch transport boundary, and both v3 message-only and v4 chat delta payloads.

## User Impact

iPhone nodes and paired-Watch relay features can connect across Gateway protocol versions 3 and 4. Current v4 behavior remains unchanged. Direct Watch mode requires v4 because its HTTPS endpoint was introduced after protocol v3; macOS/operator clients also keep requiring v4.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxdnwk97nxkgqx3jx7cjwhm1`, exact head `0ba085903c2`: generator stability, native i18n inventory, dead-export ratchet, and protocol guard — 5/5 passed ([run 29248553929](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29248553929)).
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxdmqgj99thg95f99ncdgarf`: final native protocol boundary guard — 5/5 passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxdev7s8f08n94zk8hzjzfnd`: `pnpm check:changed` — passed formatting, typechecks, lint, guards, and selected tests.
- Repository autoreview: clean on the exact final branch after correcting the direct-Watch v4 transport boundary.
- Source-blind generated-artifact check: protocol 4, general minimum 4, node minimum 3.
- macOS Swift and iOS build checks: pending PR CI.
